quiz.r.amok.name: Amok
quiz.r.amok.blurb: You're Amok: calm, graceful and worth the wait. You do things properly, and the people around you always feel looked after.
quiz.r.amok.fact: Fish steamed in a banana-leaf cup with kroeung, coconut and egg until it's soft like mousse; often called one of Cambodia's national dishes.
quiz.r.lok-lak.name: Lok Lak
quiz.r.lok-lak.blurb: You're Lok Lak: quick, confident and full of flavour. When you walk in, things start happening.
quiz.r.lok-lak.fact: Beef seared fast in a hot wok, dipped in tuk meric, a lime, salt and Kampot pepper sauce.
quiz.r.num-banh-chok.name: Num Banh Chok
quiz.r.num-banh-chok.blurb: You're Num Banh Chok: the morning person everyone loves. Simple, fresh and generous, you make sure everyone around you leaves full and happy.
quiz.r.num-banh-chok.fact: Lightly fermented rice noodles, a breakfast dish; "banhchok" means "to feed".
quiz.r.kuy-teav.name: Kuy Teav
quiz.r.kuy-teav.blurb: You're Kuy Teav: easy-going and easy to love. You let everyone add their own flavour, and you still stay clear and true to yourself.
quiz.r.kuy-teav.fact: Rice-noodle soup with a clear pork broth, eaten for breakfast all over Cambodia, with herbs and sauces so each person sets their own flavour.
quiz.r.samlor-korko.name: Samlor Korko
quiz.r.samlor-korko.blurb: You're Samlor Korko: the one who holds everyone together. You bring all kinds of people into one warm pot and never stop caring for them.
quiz.r.samlor-korko.fact: The "stirring soup": green kroeung, prahok, roasted ground rice and lots of vegetables; one of Cambodia's national dishes.
quiz.r.bai-sach-chrouk.name: Bai Sach Chrouk
quiz.r.bai-sach-chrouk.blurb: You're Bai Sach Chrouk: sweet, steady and always there. You're the friend people count on every morning, and you make ordinary days feel good.
quiz.r.bai-sach-chrouk.fact: Thin pork marinated in palm sugar, garlic, coconut milk and fish sauce, with rice; a breakfast dish.
quiz.r.kralan.name: Kralan
quiz.r.kralan.blurb: You're Kralan: warm, patient and full of good things inside. You're the friend everyone is happy to run into on a road trip, and you're always worth stopping for.
quiz.r.kralan.fact: Sticky rice with beans and coconut, roasted in bamboo tubes; a roadside snack.
quiz.r.prahok-ktis.name: Prahok Ktis
quiz.r.prahok-ktis.blurb: You're Prahok Ktis: deep, real and proudly yourself. Not everyone gets you straight away, but the ones who do love you for life.
quiz.r.prahok-ktis.fact: A dip of prahok, minced pork, kroeung and coconut cream, eaten with fresh vegetables.

privacy.body: Cookieless. We store no IP addresses or personal data. No account is needed. When enabled, GoatCounter counts page views and named events (quiz_started, quiz_finished, share_tapped) without cookies. It computes a short-lived hash of IP + User-Agent to count unique visitors and does not store the IP address. Analytics is disabled until deployment. The ?s= source tag records only which channel a link came from. Lunar dates and holidays are computed on your device. Your language preference is saved locally on your device.
